summary:
賽默飛世爾科技最新季度財報營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於預期，展現強勁的業務成長動能。
• 每股盈餘實際達 6.03 美元，優於預期的 5.71 美元，驚喜幅度達 5.60%。
• 季度營收達到 119.9 億美元，較去年同期顯著成長 10.50%。
• 核心醫療保健業務需求穩健，帶動整體財務表現超越市場共識。
ai_view:
觀點：本次財報優於預期釋出正面訊號，顯示核心需求回溫。中短期內有助於支撐股價表現並化解部分評價疑慮。後續應持續追蹤生技產業研發支出復甦力道及利潤率變化。

需留意：高達 32.98 的本益比反映市場已納入較高的成長預期，評價面偏高。；總體經濟環境變化可能影響生技與製藥客戶的研發資本支出。

summary_en:
Thermo Fisher Scientific reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and EPS, demonstrating robust business growth momentum.
• EPS actual reached $6.03, beating the estimate of $5.71 with a surprise of 5.60%.
• Quarterly revenue hit $11.99B, representing a strong YoY growth of 10.50%.
• Robust demand in core healthcare operations drove overall financial performance past market consensus.

view: The beat delivers a positive signal indicating a recovery in core demand. In the near to mid-term, this should support share prices and alleviate some valuation concerns. Key metrics to track include the recovery momentum of biotech R&D expenditures and margin trends.

Watch：A trailing P/E of 32.98 reflects high growth expectations already priced in, indicating a rich valuation.; Macroeconomic shifts could potentially impact R&D and capital expenditures of biotech and pharma clients.
